claims.text: The article gives the Air Force's own unexplained residue as a falling figure: 'The percentage of what the Air Force considered unexplained UFO sightings fell to 5.9 percent in 1955 and to 4 percent in 1956.' On Area 52 (batch 07, file 04, 0:49:22) John Ramirez attributed to this article a figure of one in ten. The article does not carry that figure.
